properties.description: Presented data matches the already accepted input prefix or completion-justified zero padding, independently of sink readiness.
Presented last markers terminate precisely the clamped 4..8-byte output frame; incomplete prefixes cannot prematurely terminate.
Presented statuses match completed accepted frames in order, with exact lengths and padding/truncation flags; status retirement is independent of data retirement.
Blocked data and status remain valid and stable; synchronous reset clears output valids and cancels outstanding epoch obligations without erasing historical alarms.

Classifies unknown meaningful observations, illegal source reset or blocked-offer behavior, input lengths exceeding twelve bytes, and bounded scoreboard exhaustion as alarms rather than successful DUT checks.

Enabled combinationally at the final-post marker: all accepted input and both response channels must be complete and empty, with no remaining offers or valids and at least 32 ready-high idle drain edges. The evaluator separately qualifies the required 128-cycle final tail; this minimum is not a certification of that qualification.
